notes: New: Layer 2. Once you've beaten a biome's boss, a 🌀 Layer 2 option opens on that biome's card at the Wilderness Gate — a harder remix with favored species spawning even more often, a denser version of the biome's own mechanic, a new ⚡ power surge hazard exclusive to Layer 2, and a much stronger boss under a new title.
Layer 2's layout is derived from the same seed you enter for Layer 1, so favoriting a seed favorites both layers.
